description: This file provides classes and utility functions for interacting with a filesystem abstraction layer within an Odoo module, including file handling, directory listing, path normalization, and file operations, tailored for cross-platform compatibility.

classes.name: file_wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around StringIO for file-like operations that saves data to the database upon closing.

classes.name: content_wrapper
classes.description: A StringIO wrapper that processes written content and saves it via a specific write method.

classes.name: abstracted_fs
classes.description: A class providing filesystem abstraction with methods for path normalization, file/directory operations, listing, and security checks, tailored for cross-platform use within an Odoo environment.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the DMS channel with error level.

methods.name: _get_month_name
methods.description: Returns the abbreviated month name given a month number.

methods.name: _to_unicode
methods.description: Converts a byte string to unicode, trying utf-8, latin, or ascii encodings.

methods.name: _to_decode
methods.description: Encodes or decodes a string to/from utf-8, latin, or ascii.

methods.name: db_list
methods.description: Returns a list of database names that contain the 'document' module and are installed.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the filesystem abstraction with default root, cwd, and rnfr attributes.

methods.name: ftpnorm
methods.description: Normalizes a virtual FTP path to an absolute system-independent path.

methods.name: ftp2fs
methods.description: Converts an FTP path to a filesystem object using the provided database context.

methods.name: fs2ftp
methods.description: Converts a filesystem node object to an FTP path string.

methods.name: validpath
methods.description: Checks if a path is within the user's root directory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new file or content wrapper in the filesystem.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a file or content node for reading.

methods.name: mkstemp
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a temporary file; not yet implemented.

methods.name: chdir
methods.description: Changes the current working directory to the specified path node.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new directory node.

methods.name: close_cr
methods.description: Closes a database cursor.

methods.name: get_cr
methods.description: Retrieves a database cursor and user ID for a given FTP path.

methods.name: listdir
methods.description: Lists directory contents or returns a list of database nodes if path is None.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory node if empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a file or attachment node.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory node, handling different types accordingly.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Returns filesystem stats for a node, with modifications for file size and modification time.

methods.name: lstat
methods.description: Alias for stat.

methods.name: isfile
methods.description: Checks if a node is a file.

methods.name: islink
methods.description: Always returns False; symbolic links are not supported.

methods.name: isdir
methods.description: Checks if a node is a directory.

methods.name: getsize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file node.

methods.name: getmtime
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a node.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonical path, no symbolic link resolution.

methods.name: lexists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Alias for lexists.

methods.name: glob1
methods.description: Returns files matching a pattern in a directory.

methods.name: get_list_dir
methods.description: Returns a directory listing formatted for FTP LIST command.

methods.name: get_stat_dir
methods.description: Returns a directory listing formatted for FTP STAT command, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Formats directory entries similar to UNIX ls -l output.

methods.name: format_mlsx
methods.description: Formats directory entries for MLSD/MLST commands with facts.
